title: The second chore coat
logline: Winter. The coat is the same coat as 2000. The drawing is not.

panels.composition: The beach, December, wind. WOOD in the chore coat — the same coat, ten years on, patched at the elbow. BARNABY carried under one arm, eleven, not walking far now.

image.prompt: a man in a patched canvas chore coat carrying an old dog under one arm on a windy December beach, wind drawn as long lines, mature brush line with gray wash

panels.composition: The coat. The elbow patch. A button that doesn't match. The same ink stain on the pocket, faded.

image.prompt: close-up of a worn canvas coat with a patched elbow, a mismatched button and a faded ink stain on the pocket

panels.composition: Wood, to the dog, not fast this time. Slow.

balloons.text: Same coat. I said if the coat's the same, the man's the same. I was twenty. Twenty is allowed to be wrong about coats.

image.prompt: a man on a windy beach speaking slowly to an old dog he carries under his arm

panels.composition: The two of them small on the beach. The coat the only dark shape. Drawn slowly, every line placed. The same panel as 2000 by a different hand.

image.prompt: two small figures on a wide windy beach, one a dark coat-shaped mark carrying a dog, drawn with slow deliberate lines, gray wash, no words
image.notes: Pair with dw_2000-12-08. Same composition; the book can print both.

art.line: brush-pen; the flats cleaner; the Sundays the point now

notes: The 2000 chore-coat strip redrawn ten years on, by a man who's slower.
